subject: Dedicated capacity renewal: term options + hardware grade change (A100 → H100 / L40S) - proposal and next steps
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, May 03 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity renewal: term options + hardware grade change (A100 → H100 / L40S) - proposal and next steps

Sara —

Thanks again for the time on Friday. Per our renewal kickoff, attached is a fresh proposal for your dedicated pool rollover. High-level summary: we can migrate your reserved fleet from A100 to H100 (or L40S hybrid) as part of the 12-month renewal with a committed +20 GPU expansion. Key points: 

- Capacity: baseline 60 reserved GPUs → proposed 80 reserved GPUs (20 added to support expected peak during model retraining/embedding refreshes)
- Hardware grade: recommended primary H100; optional L40S for mixed inference workloads (lower power, better batch density for float16/quantized models)
- Throughput guarantee: 99th-percentile per-request latency SLO + throughput floor (X tokens/s per pool) with credit schedule in amendment
- Economics: upfront committed discount plus blended per-token rate. Attached: perf_report_q2.pdf and a draft amendment (amendment-draft.docx) with SLA language and trial clause for L40S.

Can you confirm procurement timeline and whether Archipelago prefers a hybrid pool (mix of H100 + L40S) or full H100? We can set up a short technical review with Neha and Dylan this week to validate the perf-per-dollar numbers with your typical payloads.

Next steps proposed:
1) Review amendment draft (attached) — we can take procurement redlines
2) Pilot: 30-day L40S trial on a 10-GPU slice (no change to committed billing if pilot runs in parallel)
3) Sign and schedule migration window in June

Thanks — happy to iterate.

—Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0132

We’re open to a pilot but need the cost delta and a short SLA summary for procurement.

Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity renewal: term options + hardware grade change (A100 → H100 / L40S) - technical notes

Hi Sara —

Quick technical note to address your questions; attaching a short compute_breakdown.csv and a condensed perf summary (perf_report_q2.pdf). TL;DR answers below. Happy to do a live deep dive with sample payloads.

1) Cost delta (annualized):
- Baseline (60x A100): list price X; effective after discounts $A/year
- Full H100 swap (80x H100 committed): ~+24% gross annual spend vs baseline, but normalized perf-per-dollar improves ~1.6–1.8x for our typical LLM inference mix (chat + embeddings) due to higher throughput and better kernel utilization.
- Hybrid (H100 primary + 20x L40S): ~+12% gross vs baseline with similar perf-per-dollar gains for heavily-quantized/embedding paths.

2) Throughput (representative):
- A100 (fp16) median tokens/s per GPU: ~320–450 (depends on model family and seq len)
- H100 (fp16+tensor cores): ~540–770 tokens/s per GPU (measured on internal Llama-variant 7B/13B style workloads at 2048 tokens)
- L40S (quantized ops): ~400–600 tokens/s per GPU for quantized embedding-heavy workloads

3) Latency (small-batch <8 tokens):
- p95 delta: H100 generally reduces p95 by ~20–30ms vs A100 for our targeted seq lengths due to faster kernel dispatch and larger L2 -> faster KV cache utilization. p99 improvements present but smaller on cold-cache requests.

4) SLA / credits:
- We recommend a throughput floor (tokens/s per pool) and latency SLO (p99 tail). Credit schedule in the draft: 5–25% credit proportional to missed SLO windows. Will include specific numbers in amendment draft.

Operational notes: switching to H100 also unlocks denser batching and lower per-token energy costs. For Archipelago’s traffic pattern (spiky at day boundary), a hybrid pool with L40S for embeddings and H100 for chat workload tends to maximize perf-per-dollar.

If this looks good I can present the numbers in a 30-minute technical walkthrough with sample payloads on Thursday.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments: compute_breakdown.csv, perf_report_q2.pdf

Subject: Internal: Archipelago renewal - suggested commercial motion

Laura / Dylan —

Following Neha’s tech summary, proposing we offer Archipelago: 

- Commercial: 12-month commit for 80 GPUs (20 added) with a blended discount; allow 30-day L40S pilot covering 10 GPUs with no credit to baseline commit (pilot runs in parallel). If pilot demonstrates expected perf-per-dollar, convert pilot to committed L40S portion and prorate billing for remainder of term.
- SLA: 99th percentile latency target + throughput floor; financial credits tiered (5% / 10% / 20%) for sustained misses.
- Migration: 2-week migration window in June; ops support from Dylan + one-week on-call during cutover.

Please confirm we can offer the credit bands and pilot terms as written. If yes, I’ll incorporate into amendment-draft.docx and share with procurement.

—Markus
